title: EXP-077 - Hello World Part 5 Prerequisite D: Enter Address Values for FX001 and FX002 at Runtime
objective: Last Address prerequisite for Hello World Part 5 (operator decision 2026-10-13). EXP-076 added the Multi-Line Address field FX_AddressEdit (bound to FX_Address, caption Address) to the User-scoped FX_HelloWorld01 Form. In the Web Client runtime FX_HelloWorld01 Form, load the two existing rows with one toolbar Refresh and verify FX001 / Factory test one and FX002 / Factory test two with empty Address. Then fill only the Address of each existing row: FX001 = 1 Factory Street and FX002 = 2 Factory Street (one plain fill each, no Enter), verify both before exactly one toolbar Save, close and reopen the runtime Form once, refresh once and verify that both addresses are recovered with Code and Label unchanged. No row is added or deleted. Findings are observed only (same session, UI level).

in_scope: Read AGENTS.md, docs/mongoose/transcripts/hello-world-pt5.md Sections 1-2, the EXP-076 record (FX_AddressEdit, runtime presentation), the EXP-042-R3 record (FX_HelloWorld01 runtime: uncaptioned Label and Code inputs, Refresh loads the rows, FX_Code read-only after Save) and the EXP-046 record (count rule, typed values reach the grid on blur) before browser interaction.
Create or update only experiments/EXP-077-hello-world-part-5-prereq-d-fx-address-values.md and evidence/EXP-077/ documentation and evidence files.
Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Use the existing authenticated session without refresh, restart or configuration change. If it expires, follow the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure once and end the task. List the browser tabs before the first tab selection. Do not touch the Web Designer tab.

Preflight: use the FX_HelloWorld01 runtime tab if it is open and clean, otherwise open it once through Form > Open > Select Form. Invoke one toolbar Refresh and verify exactly two rows, FX001 / Factory test one and FX002 / Factory test two, each with an empty Address field, status (Object n of 2) and Save disabled. If a row is missing or an Address is not empty, stop.

Row FX001: make it current by clicking its grid row once; click into the Address field and fill 1 Factory Street by one plain fill (no Enter, no other key except one Tab to move focus out); verify the Address value and that Code FX001 and Label Factory test one are unchanged.

Row FX002: make it current by clicking its grid row once; fill 2 Factory Street into the Address field the same way; verify it, and verify that FX001 still shows 1 Factory Street when it is selected again (one row click), with both rows dirty and no third row.
Perform exactly one ordinary toolbar Save after both values are verified; record the native response, the Save state and both rows afterwards.

Close the clean FX_HelloWorld01 runtime Form once through its Form-tab control and reopen it once through Form > Open > Select Form; invoke one toolbar Refresh; verify for each row Code, Label and Address (1 Factory Street and 2 Factory Street) and the status count.
Capture screenshots of the preflight rows, each row after its fill, both rows before Save, the Save result, the reopened Form and each recovered row.
Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. Classify findings as observed only.

FX001 Address filled with 1 Factory Street by one plain fill; Code and Label unchanged. Evidence: row screenshot.
FX002 Address filled with 2 Factory Street by one plain fill; FX001 still shows 1 Factory Street; no third row; Code and Label unchanged. Evidence: screenshots of both rows before Save.
Exactly one toolbar Save with the native response (or its absence); Save disabled afterwards; both rows show their addresses. Evidence: Save screenshot.
The clean runtime Form closed once without a prompt and reopened once through Select Form. Evidence: reopen screenshot.

After one Refresh, both rows recovered: FX001 / Factory test one / 1 Factory Street and FX002 / Factory test two / 2 Factory Street, status count recorded, Save disabled. Evidence: one screenshot per row.

The final EXP-077 report gives decisive evidence for AC-1 to AC-6, the complete action audit with exact counts (two Refreshes, two fills, one Save, one runtime close/reopen, zero New/Delete, zero Code/Label edits, zero Designer actions, zero metadata changes, zero unloads, re-login count), the worker-written-file inventory and the final state.
